newsitem.title: UK: ICI's ICIA over-allotment option exercised.
newsitem.headline: ICI's ICIA over-allotment option exercised.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc (ICI) said on Thursday it had been notified that the over-allotment option had been fully exercised in the float of its majority stake in ICI Australia Ltd (ICIA).
The option allows for the purchase of around 12 million shares at A$12.35 each to cover over-allotments.
The initial offering of 143 million shares closed oversubscribed last Friday at a fixed price of A$12.35 for institutions and A$11.95 for retail investors.
Taken together with the buy-back of 30 million shares and today's over-allotment option, ICI said it has divested itself of all its 185 million shares in ICI Australia.
ICI announced in May that it would sell most of its 62.4 percent stake in ICIA to help fund its US$8 billion acquisition of Unilever's specialty chemical business.
